description: Build the standardized prompt for a fresh reviewer subagent that evaluates implemented work against its spec without access to the implementation conversation. Use after an implementer subagent completes a spec slice (when the slice is ready for REVIEWED), or after a deviation log is written (for reconciliation review). Do not use for ad-hoc code review unrelated to a spec, or for reviewing a spec's authorship (that's the READY_FOR_REVIEW step in spec-workflow).
